result: If I had the power to change the world in one way, I’d work to cultivate genuine empathy and understanding among all people. I believe much of our global strife stems from not truly hearing or appreciating one another—our different backgrounds, perspectives, or even deeply held convictions. Imagine a world where, before deciding or reacting, people stepped back to really consider how their actions might affect someone else. I’d strive to create a culture where communication is sincere and differences are celebrated, not feared. In that environment, conflicts would give way to collaboration, and solutions would focus on healing and progress rather than division.
